qc.label_under_test: The 'as' or 'a' right after me, us or you when that person is labelled back: an earlier clause has me, us or you casting someone else as a kind of person (seeing, thinking of or treating them as something), and a following clause has that other person cast me, us or you in return with a noun. Weak: the same return clause aimed at a third person, a one-way label of me or you with no earlier clause, me labelled first and then answering back, official appointments to a post, and adjective labels.

neighbours.label: The 'as' (or the 'a' just after it) when me, us or you is labelled back: an earlier clause has me, us or you seeing, thinking of, regarding or treating someone else as something, and a following clause has that other person see, think of, regard or treat me, us or you 'as' something in return; the return can end in a noun or an adjective. Weak: the same return clause aimed at a third person (him, her, them, a brother), a one-way label of me, us or you with no earlier clause, me labelled first and then answering back, the bare form without 'as' (thinks me foolish, considers me a fool), and official appointments to a post.
fire: I always saw him as a mentor, but he only ever saw me as a nuisance.
We treated the newcomers as family, and in time they came to treat us as family too.
You think of her as a rival, yet she thinks of you as a friend.
I regarded the old captain as a hero, and he regarded me as a son.
We considered them partners, while they considered us as little more than customers.
She viewed you as an equal, so naturally you hoped she would view you as trustworthy, and she did come to see you as reliable.
I thought of Marco as my closest ally, but Marco thought of me as a convenient pawn.
We welcomed the villagers as neighbours, and they welcomed us as guests of honour.
quiet: I always saw him as a mentor, but he only ever saw my brother as a nuisance.
We treated the newcomers as family, and in time they came to treat their hosts kindly too.
You think of her as a rival, yet she thinks you foolish.
I regarded the old captain as a hero, and he regarded his first mate as a son.
The board appointed me as treasurer at the annual meeting last spring.
Everyone at the office sees me as the quiet one.
I thought of Marco as my closest ally, but Marco never thought about me at all.
We welcomed the villagers warmly, and they welcomed us with bread and music.

predictions: Blind test (label-only author). Expect most fire items above 0.30; the 'view you as trustworthy' item may be weak since it is not a clean return; near misses low.
